experiment.description: Craze & Crash Shorts: frame 1 is the document with the figure highlighted, against the object-first frame (judged on stayed to watch)
experiment.on: Frame 1 (weekly loop, cycle 1, doc-document-first, on): the first frame is the document: a report table, filing, price list or receipt with the story's sourced figure already highlighted (from params.fig, shown with its Data line), the subject named by 1 s; the object the viewer knows enters after it. Everything else as the recipe says.
experiment.off: Frame 1 (weekly loop, cycle 1, doc-document-first, off): the champion: the first frame is the object the viewer knows (the toy at an auction, the cup going into a car), the subject named by 1 s; no document in the first shot. Everything else as the recipe says.
experiment.why: 0 of 8 Shorts a side have two days of data; day 4 of 7
